events.event_hazard: Meteotsunami induced by an atmospheric inertia–gravity wave
key_impacts: Shoreline and nearby city streets were flooded near Ludington.
Damage reported to shoreline homes, public docks, cottages, and boat docks.
Water intake pumps at a hydroelectric facility were impacted.
Water levels fluctuated ~0.5 m inside the harbor; about 2 m reported along the open coast.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
NWS received reports of 2 m fluctuations outside the harbor; the harbor gauge recorded up to 0.5 m.
missing_information: Quantities of damaged homes/docks not specified.
Exact flooded street locations and extent not detailed.
